title: Menu
description: A menu of the site — in one line, as a line with dropdowns, or in columns for a footer.

schema.label: Menu
schema.help: Filled with the menus of the site when the block was installed. A menu made later is added to this list in the block type’s form. Empty is the header.

schema.label: Layout
schema.help: One line shows the top level only; the other two show two levels.
